title: Pinned app disappears from Task Manager when its window is moved to another virtual desktop
line: A pinned app no longer vanishes from the Task Manager when its only window is moved to another virtual desktop
explanation: Task Manager hides a pinned launcher while a matching window passes its filters, but the filter model only re-checked launchers when a window was added or removed, changed app id, or changed screen. Moving the window to another desktop removed the window row but left the launcher hidden (and moving it back showed both), until some unrelated window geometry change or a desktop switch re-filtered everything. The reporter's open MR !7394 re-filters launchers whenever a window role that one of the enabled filters looks at changes (virtual desktops, activities, minimized, skip taskbar, screen, ...).

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: le-filter launchers on any filtered window change.
also a new test.

BUG: 528684

media.caption: Pure master: Dolphin opened from its pinned icon, then its window is moved to desktop 2 while desktop 1 stays current; the Dolphin icon disappears from the panel and stays gone.
Same steps with MR !7394: the pinned Dolphin launcher comes back as soon as the window leaves the desktop.
Panel (2x): Dolphin running on desktop 1; 3 s and 8 s after moving it to desktop 2, no Dolphin icon.
Panel (2x), same moments with the fix: the pinned Dolphin launcher is back.

review.text: MR !7394 fixes the cause: launchers were only re-filtered for AppId, launcher URL and screen changes, not for the other roles that decide whether a window hides its launcher. The role-to-filter mapping is complete and comes with a good new autotest, and the rig run shows the launcher coming back after a desktop move with no regressions. The reporter should fix the commit subject (typo 'le-filter', not KDE style) on the MR. It fits with 528323's sorting fix.
